title: Iterating on the design of Carthage in my RTS
author: standardofiron
selftext:
I've been working on the city of Carthage for my game, Standard of Iron, experimenting with the layout of marketplaces, rivers, roads, buildings and gardens.

My workflow is fairly simple. I have a custom map editor where I place and adjust everything visually. The editor generates a JSON map definition that the game loads at runtime, so I can quickly see how things look in the actual game.

I use Opus 5.5 to help develop and improve the editor, write validation tools and make the iteration process smoother. I'm still designing the city myself, but AI helps me build the tools that make it much easier.

As a developer, I probably wouldn't have invested this much time in custom tooling before, but now I find myself constantly improving my workflow.

The video shows the current state of Carthage. Still a work in progress!

The game is open source: [https://github.com/djeada/Standard-of-Iron](https://github.com/djeada/Standard-of-Iron)
